explanation: Agent maps and usage text corrected. catalog.json describes geo_replication as pipeline scripts and config with study data restored by fetch:data, and the ui-change workflow now owns statistics, library, hub, circadian, compare and methodology. The context README drops the pnpm -- argument, the Git LFS claim and the separate CI workflow. Script headers stop citing build:tracker, prebuild and .mjs names, mark maintainer-only inputs, and document --check, --out, --all-tracks, --no-zip and env vars. seoPages pluralises one study; seoGuides keeps the software citation apart from the data-export DOI. Sealed or hash-pinned scripts were left unchanged.
